about: Flagship access list (docs/ai-privacy-and-staging.md §3a). Every platform's parser, matcher, editor and signer must pass every case here. In decide cases, "rule" is the 1-based position among the parsed rules (comments and blank lines don't count), null when the default deny applied. A new app's list is defaultList.
defaultList:
# Uncomment the following line to allow all hosts
#allow all

parse.list:
# weather app
allow api.open-meteo.com
allow *.tile.openstreetmap.org  # map tiles
deny all

write the host only, without a path
write the host only, without a port
IP addresses can't be allowed or denied; use a host name
a * may only start a host, as in *.example.com
"localhost" is not a public host name
"-bad.com" is not a valid host name
say what to allow or deny, e.g. "allow example.com"
"x..com" is not a valid host name
